title: Tuscan Garlic Butter Salmon
description: Pan-seared Atlantic salmon fillets resting in a velvety sun-dried tomato, spinach, and garlic cream sauce.

steps.title: Season Salmon
steps.instruction: Pat salmon fillets thoroughly dry with paper towels. Season both sides generously with salt, cracked black pepper, and paprika.
steps.tip: Dry skin creates a crispier sear in the hot pan.

steps.title: Pan Sear
steps.instruction: Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add salmon fillets skin-side down and sear for 5 minutes until crisp and golden, then flip and cook for another 3-4 minutes. Transfer salmon to a warm plate.
steps.tip: Don't move the salmon during the first 4 minutes to ensure a golden crust.

steps.title: Make Tuscan Cream Sauce
steps.instruction: In the same skillet, sauté minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant. Add sun-dried tomatoes and cook for 1 minute. Pour in heavy cream and chicken broth, bringing to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Fold Spinach & Finish
steps.instruction: Stir in grated parmesan until melted and creamy. Add fresh baby spinach and allow to wilt gently. Return salmon fillets to the skillet, spooning sauce over each piece.
steps.tip: Serve immediately with lemon wedges and crusty bread or wild rice.

title: Crispy Lemon Herb Chicken Quinoa Bowl
description: Marinated grilled chicken breast served over fluffy herbed quinoa, crisp Persian cucumbers, kalamata olives, and feta drizzle.

steps.title: Cook Quinoa
steps.instruction: Rinse quinoa in a fine-mesh strainer. Combine with 240ml water and a pinch of salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce heat to low for 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
steps.tip: Let quinoa rest off the heat covered for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork.

steps.title: Marinate Chicken
steps.instruction: Toss chicken breast with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Let sit for 5-10 minutes.

steps.title: Grill Chicken
steps.instruction: Heat a grill pan or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 74°C (165°F). Rest 5 minutes, then slice diagonally.

steps.title: Assemble Bowls
steps.instruction: Divide fluffy quinoa into two shallow bowls. Arrange sliced chicken, cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and kalamata olives. Top with crumbled feta and drizzle with remaining lemon vinaigrette.

title: Avocado & Poached Egg Sourdough
description: Artisan toasted sourdough smeared with lemon garlic mashed avocado, topped with two runny poached eggs, chili flakes, and microgreens.

steps.title: Mash Avocado
steps.instruction: Scoop avocado into a bowl with fresh lemon juice, a pinch of flaky sea salt, and black pepper. Mash with a fork leaving slight texture.

steps.title: Toast Bread
steps.instruction: Toast sourdough slices until golden and crisp. Optionally brush lightly with extra virgin olive oil.

steps.title: Poach Eggs
steps.instruction: Bring a shallow pot of water with 1 tbsp vinegar to a bare simmer. Create a gentle whirlpool with a spoon, slide in cracked eggs one at a time, and cook for 3 minutes for a luscious runny yolk.
steps.tip: Very fresh eggs hold their shape much better in the poaching vortex.

steps.title: Assemble & Garnish
steps.instruction: Spread avocado generously across both toasts. Lift eggs with a slotted spoon, dry gently on paper towel, and place atop avocado. Sprinkle with chili flakes, flaky salt, and cracked pepper.

title: Authentic Beef Bolognese Pappardelle
description: Slow-simmered rich Italian ragù with minced beef, sofrito, crushed San Marzano tomatoes, and whole milk tossed with wide pappardelle ribbons.

steps.title: Sauté Sofrito
steps.instruction: In a heavy-bottomed Dutch oven, heat olive oil over medium. Add onion, celery, and carrot with a pinch of salt. Cook gently for 8-10 minutes until soft and translucent.

steps.title: Brown Beef
steps.instruction: Push vegetables to side and add ground beef. Break up meat with a wooden spoon and brown deeply for 6-8 minutes until caramelized.

steps.title: Simmer Sauce
steps.instruction: Stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes. Pour in milk and let simmer until absorbed. Add crushed tomatoes, reduce heat to low, cover partially and simmer for 30 minutes.
steps.tip: Milk tenderizes the meat fibres creating traditional silky bolognese texture.

steps.title: Cook Pasta & Toss
steps.instruction: Boil pappardelle in salted water until al dente (about 8 mins). Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water. Toss hot pasta directly into the ragù, adding pasta water as needed. Garnish with fresh parmigiano.

title: Berry Blast Greek Yogurt Parfait
description: Creamy high-protein vanilla Greek yogurt layered with wild blueberry chia compote, crunchy pecan granola, and raw honey.

steps.title: Layer Yogurt Base
steps.instruction: Spoon half of the thick Greek yogurt into a clear glass or dessert cup.

steps.title: Add Berry Layer
steps.instruction: Layer fresh blueberries and raspberries, then sprinkle half of the chia seeds and granola.

steps.title: Final Layer & Drizzle
steps.instruction: Top with the remaining Greek yogurt, remaining berries, crunchy granola, and drizzle with golden honey.
steps.tip: High in protein and gut-healthy probiotics to kickstart your morning.

title: Thai Red Curry with Crispy Tofu
description: Golden pan-fried tofu cubes immersed in an aromatic lemongrass and red curry coconut broth with bell peppers, bamboo shoots, and Thai basil.

steps.title: Crisp the Tofu
steps.instruction: Toss pressed tofu cubes with 1 tsp cornstarch. Pan fry in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes until golden and crispy on all sides. Set aside.
steps.tip: Pressing the tofu for 10 minutes beforehand guarantees maximum crispiness.

steps.title: Fry Curry Paste
steps.instruction: In the same pan, heat 1 tsp oil and fry the red curry paste for 1 minute until deeply fragrant and oil begins to separate.

steps.title: Simmer Coconut Broth
steps.instruction: Pour in creamy coconut milk, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Bring to a gentle boil, then add bell peppers and zucchini. Simmer for 5-6 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender.

steps.title: Combine & Serve
steps.instruction: Stir in crisp tofu and fresh Thai basil leaves. Remove from heat immediately. Serve hot over jasmine rice.

title: Avocado Lime Shrimp Tacos
description: Chili-cumin rubbed grilled jumbo shrimp nestled in warm corn tortillas with crunchy cilantro slaw, creamy avocado crema, and cotija cheese.

steps.title: Season Shrimp
steps.instruction: Toss shrimp in a bowl with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, pinch of salt, and 1 tsp olive oil.

steps.title: Make Slaw & Crema
steps.instruction: Toss shredded purple cabbage with juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt. Mash avocado with lime juice, cilantro, and a spoonful of Greek yogurt or sour cream.

steps.title: Sear Shrimp
steps.instruction: Heat skillet over high heat. Add shrimp and sear for 2 minutes per side until pink, opaque, and lightly charred.
steps.tip: Shrimp cook very fast; avoid overcooking to keep them tender.

steps.title: Char Tortillas & Plate
steps.instruction: Warm tortillas directly over gas flame or dry skillet for 30 seconds per side. Fill each with cabbage slaw, seared shrimp, avocado crema, and crumbled cotija.

title: Matcha Chia Seed Pudding with Mango
description: Silky ceremonial grade green tea chia seed pudding soaked overnight in oat milk, layered with diced sweet honey mango and toasted coconut flakes.

steps.title: Whisk Matcha Base
steps.instruction: Whisk matcha powder with 2 tbsp warm water until smooth and frothy without clumps. Stir in oat milk and pure maple syrup.

steps.title: Combine Chia
steps.instruction: Whisk chia seeds into the matcha milk mixture. Stir vigorously for 2 minutes to prevent seeds from clumping at the bottom.

steps.title: Chill to Set
steps.instruction: Refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight until thickened to pudding consistency.
steps.tip: Give it one more stir after 15 minutes of chilling for the most uniform texture.

steps.title: Top & Enjoy
steps.instruction: Divide into jars, top with fresh diced sweet mango cubes and toasted coconut flakes.

title: Dark Chocolate Lava Cake with Sea Salt
description: Warm individual molten chocolate soufflé cake made with 72% single-origin dark cocoa, featuring an oozing molten center and flaky Maldon salt.

steps.title: Melt Chocolate & Butter
steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Butter two 6oz ramekins and dust with cocoa powder. Gently melt dark chocolate and butter in a heatproof bowl over simmering water.

steps.title: Whisk Eggs & Sugar
steps.instruction: In a medium bowl, whisk eggs, sugar, and vanilla until pale and frothy (about 2 minutes).

steps.title: Fold Batter
steps.instruction: Fold melted chocolate mixture into the eggs, followed by the sifted flour. Divide batter equally into prepared ramekins.

steps.title: Bake & Invert
steps.instruction: Bake for 11-12 minutes until sides are set but center is still soft and jiggly. Run a knife around edge, invert onto plates, and sprinkle with Maldon flaky sea salt.
steps.tip: Timing is crucial! Even 1 extra minute can bake the molten center solid.

title: Mediterranean Shakshuka with Feta
description: North African spiced tomato and red bell pepper sauce simmering with cumin, smoked paprika, gently poached whole eggs, and salty sheep feta.

steps.title: Sauté Aromatics
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion and bell pepper for 6 minutes until tender. Add minced garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika; cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer Rich Sauce
steps.instruction: Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer gently for 8 minutes until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Poach Eggs in Sauce
steps.instruction: Use a spoon to create 4 shallow wells in the bubbling sauce. Crack an egg into each well. Cover pan and cook on low heat for 5-7 minutes until whites are set and yolks remain runny.
steps.tip: Keep an eye on the eggs in the last 2 minutes so the yolks stay golden and liquid.

steps.title: Garnish & Serve
steps.instruction: Sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese, chopped fresh cilantro, and chili flakes. Serve immediately hot straight from the skillet with warm pita or sourdough.
